name: wellbore-scatter-and-bullet-method
purpose: Reusable chart semantics for the local engine test UI

scatterPlot.series: Each metric is a paired x/y series. The y values are shared measured-depth rows.
scatterPlot.threshold: Represent a constant limit as a second paired series spanning the same depth range.
scatterPlot.markers: Use small point markers for station data and a continuous line for dense profiles.
scatterPlot.labels: Label axes with engineering units and keep the depth direction increasing downward.

bulletChart.accessibility: Expose the actual, target, and limit values as text alongside the visual track.
